newsitem.title: USA: Mellon to buy benefits firm Buck Consultants.
newsitem.headline: Mellon to buy benefits firm Buck Consultants.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said it agreed to buy benefits consulting firm Buck Consultants Inc for an undisclosed amount.

New York-based Buck, which is privately owned, serves pension and other benefit plans with assets totaling about $400 billion, Mellon said. Buck had revenues of $197 million for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, Mellon added.

Under the agreement, Buck will become a Mellon subsidiary and keep its current management team, Mellon said. The acquisition is subject to due diligence and the approval of Buck shareholders, Mellon added.
